properties.name: FIELD REPORT (xrt-demo genesis, Claude Code on Opus 5, 2026-09-16): a 7.5 KB brief seeded into 41 nodes with no xrt call yet — 8 wins, 12 frictions, 3 ideas; worst: add_artifact silently wrote `realized` on six deliverables that do not exist, and the cross-type duplicate guard refused seven writes that were all golden-thread pairs
properties.statement:
Reported by the agent running /genesis on /home/ajs7/project/xrt-demo/demo.md (its file: reflow2_feedback.md, 336 lines; copied to docs/feedback/2026-09-16-xrt-demo-genesis-feedback.md). No xrt-mcp call was made, so every finding is about reflow2 alone.

WORKED (its words, condensed): W1 reflow2_start_design attached the full surface with no client restart, via tools/list_changed — "the happy path is clean and should be stated first rather than after three paragraphs of caveat". W2 the near-duplicate guard's two tiers (refuse across types, advise within) "subtle and correct" — before the structure round. W3 add_capability's inline satisfies "saved roughly ten round-trips"; refusing the whole write when the id names nothing is the right failure mode. W4 "tool descriptions that carry their own evidence changed my behaviour … worth naming as a deliberate convention, because it is doing real work". W5 create_node's merge + prior_state_preserved_in made recovering from its own mistake one call per node. W6 the constraint/requirement/rule three-way split "held up under a real brief". W7 inline satisfies/allocated_to survived distinct_from — proved by re-running detection (unallocated 5→1). W8 detect_gaps "degraded honestly under a tight budget … the best-behaved truncation I have seen in a tool API".

FRICTION: F1 (worst) add_artifact has no `status` and the schema default `realized` was materialised on all eight artifacts, six of which do not exist — "an affirmative claim that work is done"; set_artifact_intent does not cover status; fallback was create_node. F2 set_provenance accepts four types; Constraint, DesignRule, Decision, Artifact cannot say how they entered the graph — worked around with authored_by, "authorship, not how it entered". F3 provenance is per node but captured nodes are mixed: statement verbatim the user's, priority/concern invented by the agent — no field-level provenance. F4 describe_schema has no properties-only mode: required_only useless for the question, full 24,005 chars. F5 genesis's bolded "do NOT create Components yet" has no escape clause for a brief that already states the structure concretely — the agent withheld what the user wrote to fire a detector that would ask for it. F6 constrains defaults basis=estimated when no contribution is passed — nine edges assert the basis of a number that isn't there. F7 ~20 tool schemas fetched across four rounds before the first write; get_skill could return the tools a skill needs. F8 (jointly worst, after the structure round) the cross-type guard blocked seven writes — cap↔rule, cmp:dcm↔req:bandwidth, cmp:agent-seam↔req:agent-is-the-seam, cmp:tooling↔cmp:verify-script, and three capability↔the component it was being ALLOCATED_TO in the same call — all resolved distinct_from, none a duplicate: "the pairs the guard flags are exactly the pairs reflow2's own golden thread is built to join". F9 a Flow cannot model a physical ordered path — part_of_flow takes a capability, the beam path is parts. F10 nowhere to put a dimensioned physical property (25.5 m, 3 mrad, 1.0 mm, Rh, Si111) — undeclared keys, which nothing reads and the units constraint cannot check. F11 a childless root component cannot satisfy both hierarchy rules: `component` → level_spine_disagreement, `system` → orphan_level. F12 Interface.medium has no value for a photon beam; three boundaries left `unspecified`.

NEUTRAL: N1 loop hints well judged. N2 "detecting is not asking" was right and nearly broken. N3 14 of 21 open findings are unrealized_capability one per capability on a project where nothing is built — "two thirds of everything the design has to say is one detector repeating itself". N4 the guard caught a cross-type pair it would have missed.

IDEAS: I1 a genesis-from-file path. I2 a "what did I infer?" report. I3 "status defaults should never be affirmative claims" — a sweep of the constructor class.
